lines.text: A flag! Fall, and you start again here.
Flick up just before the edge.
Jump onto the mushroom to bounce high.
Flick up again midair to jump twice.
Flick up onto the mushroom to bounce.
Reach the shrine to finish the stage.
Follow the petals
Stay on the petals, high or low
Still 77 petals to collect!
It's sealed. Collect 67 more petals first.
Tap to punch it when it's close.
Tap to punch the sleeping snake.
Flick up onto the mushroom to bounce.
A snake guards the rope
Still 16 predators to defeat!
It's sealed. Defeat 16 more predators first.
Slide your thumb up to climb.
Slide your thumb to creep along.
The squirrels' lift! Fill the basket to raise it.
A long way across. Keep sliding
The basket hangs high this time.
Flick up onto the mushroom to bounce.
Creaky branches! Grab the petals and keep moving
Shaky branches drop. Don't stop on them!
Still 82 petals to collect!
Something shiny, far away...
It's sealed. Collect 72 more petals first.
Flick up as you swing forward to leap.
That vine is too high. Climb the tree!
Flick up onto the mushroom to bounce.
Keep sliding into the log to push it
Too high! Push the log onto the near end.
Fell? Climb the next tree back up
The log's on the far side. Push it back onto the far end!
Slide down in a bush to hide.
Run when it has gone by
Bushes on the rope too. Hang in one to hide.
Slide down in a bush to hide!
It saw you! Slide down in a bush!
Hide! Into a bush!
Bushes on the rope too. Hang in one to hide.
Hide! Into a bush!
This branch goes on and on
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
It's breaking behind us! Keep moving!
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
It's all coming down! Get to the vine!
Tap to punch it after it strikes.
Still 20 predators to defeat!
It's sealed. Defeat 20 more predators first.
Missed? Splash! Try again from the bank.
Deep water now. Stay on the logs!
A raft across the river! Find the lever.
Still 79 flowers to collect!
It's sealed. Collect 54 more flowers first.
Tap twice to break the cage.
A cage on a rope! Stones in the basket lift it.
The stones are on the island. Throw one over!
The basket hangs high. Flick up to throw!
Still 5 animals to free!
It's sealed. Free 5 more animals first.
Missed? Splash! Try again from the bank.
Swing to the island, then ride the logs!
Snappers! Hit one from behind, or jump on it.
Head-on it hides. Flick sideways to kick!
Kick a shell into the others!
Still 32 predators to defeat!
It's sealed. Defeat 32 more predators first.
A long way across. Keep sliding
Hop along the porches
Deep water now. Stay on the logs!
Flick up when it swings close.
Step into the basket. It carries you up!
Swing across on the rope frames!
The water's rising! Free them, then back to the bank!
A stone in the basket lifts the cage. Before the water rises!
Deep water now. Be quick!
Stepping stones. Hop, hop, hop!
The stones are on the next island. Throw one over!
Still 10 animals to free!
It's sealed. Free 10 more animals first.
Head-on he blocks. Hit him from behind, or kick him!
Up the steps, and hop along the porches!
Up to the gallery! Ring the bell, and come down behind the guards.
Ring the bell. The guards will come and look!
Still 23 predators to defeat!
It's sealed. Defeat 23 more predators first.
No moss down there. Jump true!
Mushrooms puff sleepy spores. Wait for them to clear
Glowworms! They light up when you stand still.
Too dark to see. Stand still and listen...
Glowworms! They light up when you stand still.
Too dark again. Stand still and listen...
Eyes! Slide down in a fern to hide.
Slide down in a fern to hide!
Hide! Into a fern!
Eyes can't see you in a fern. Glowworms can.
The way up is up there somewhere, out of the light.
A prowler! Tap twice, or flick to kick.
Footprints... a prowler is near
Flick up when it crouches. Three hits!
Glowworms! They light up when you stand still.
Still 14 predators to defeat!
No moss down there. Jump true!
It's sealed. Defeat 14 more predators first.
Lift your thumb and freeze! A vine's waking.
A thorn vine! Freeze while it looks, go while it sleeps
A long way across. Keep sliding
Grandma said the old thorn vines were asleep...
Lift your thumb and freeze! A vine's waking.
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
Glowworms! They light up when you stand still.
In the dark, standing still does two things
Two of them, both awake.
No moss down there. Jump true!
Slide down by a rustling fern to search.
Some stages hide things up high. Have a look.
Glowworms! They light up when you stand still.
Dark ferns too. Stand still; the glowworms help you look.
Still 5 keepsakes to find!
It's sealed. Find 5 more keepsakes first.
More! Slide down by a rustling fern.
Lift your thumb and freeze! A vine's waking.
Glowworms! They light up when you stand still.
The eyes are back. Search between their looks.
Slide down in a fern to hide!
Here, crouching by a fern does three things at once.
I marked this one too. Same kind of stone as the one by the door.
Still 6 keepsakes to find!
It's sealed. Find 6 more keepsakes first.
Thorn vines between the lianas. Don't touch the thorns!
Lift your thumb and freeze! A vine's waking.
No moss down there. Jump true!
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
One hangs over the landing. Freeze if it wakes.
Pawprints in a circle, and they all go one way...
Two prowlers! Keep one in front of you
No moss down there. Jump true!
Prowlers! Drive them all off to open the way.
Still 21 predators to defeat!
It's sealed. Defeat 21 more predators first.
Rocks! Stop at the shadow. Go once it falls.
Ouch! Stop before the shadow. Go once it falls.
I knotted us a pulley! Fill the basket.
A long way across. Keep sliding
A curled fern. Stand still beside it and wait.
Chimes! Wind's coming. Jump with it behind you.
Chimes swinging at you? Headwind. Wait for it to drop.
Something shiny, far out from the top of that tree...
The wind turns halfway! The big stone's chimes warn you.
The water pushes you down. Climb up and stop it.
Another fall. Hop up beside it and stop it.
Monkey by that petal! If it grabs it, chase it.
This fall fills the pool. Ride the log first!
Flick up twice from the log's near end.
Climb when it goes quiet. Wait in the cave.
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
Flick up twice when it's at the top.
Ouch! Stop before the shadow. Go once it falls.
Flick up twice when it's at the top.
This one comes and goes. Climb when it's quiet.
Two falls, two beats. Climb one, then wait.
Wind crosses the gorges here. Listen for the chimes.
No wind? Flick up again as you fly.
Chimes swinging at you? Hang on till the wind drops.
Tied too high! Stand on the glowing spot. I'll untie it.
Rocks on the landing! Hang on till one falls, then go.
Headwind and rocks! Hang on for both.
Another knot! Stand on the glowing spot. I'll untie it.
Another vine tied up in the trees... what is it for?
The Sky Sovereign is hunting. Stay under cover!
Her shadow! Slide down in a bush.
Slide down in a bush. Or behind falls!
Tap to knock its fruit down. It'll eat.
Hide! Water or a bush!
Tap to knock its fruit down. It'll eat.
Hide! Water or a bush!
Two lookouts! Knock the second fruit down from behind the falls.
Slide to fly me. Flick up to flap.
The shutter stops the wind. Pinwheels wind lifts!
Snakes! Tap to punch, or hop over.
The shutter stops the wind. Pinwheels wind lifts!
Thick mist! Stand still and it shows the ledges. Remember them.
Rocks! Stop at the shadow. Go once it falls.
Ouch! Stop before the shadow. Go once it falls.
Shh! One's waking. Lift your thumb and freeze.
Rocks! Stop at the shadow. Go once it falls.
Stop on this ledge too. The mist above settles.
Only way is down. Miss a ledge: back to the flag.
Slipped? Flick up and hold. Your leaf opens.
Rocks drop through the gaps. Watch for grit, then go.
A cave below! Step off, turn round, drop in.
Ouch! Stop before the shadow. Go once it falls.
Warm air! Glide into it and it lifts you.
The path turns. Step off, turn round, drop down.
A rock in the warm air! Let it pass, then rise.
Too far even for the leaf. Rise in the warm air first.
Another cave. Step off, turn round, drop in.
The deepest drops now. Glide and aim for each ledge.
Tap twice to tear the netting
Tied out of reach. Stand under the knot; I'll fly up.
Chimes! Wind's coming. Jump with it behind you.
Me first, then your leaf. The nest's a glide away.
Another guard, another knot. Me first, then the chimes.
Still 20 animals to free!
The capuchin took our stone. It loves mangoes!
Something shiny, far out past that nest...
It's sealed. Free 20 more animals first.
There, Pokey. That heap of sticks up top. Her aerie.
Rocks up here too! Stop before the shadow.
8 guards stand between us and her.
Tied again! Stand under the knot. I'll fly up.
And a guard at the top. Wait for the chimes
The water pushes you back. Stop it at the top!
Grit! A rock's coming. Let it pass, then glide.
Warm air! Glide into it to rise.
When the wind blows it off, run and glide!
Two guards, two gusts. Pass one, then wait behind the next.
Mist again! Stand still and it shows the ledges.
A guard, then rocks. Get past, then stop at the shadow.
Ouch! Stop before the shadow. Go once it falls.
A guard, then rocks. Get past, then stop at the shadow.
That feather was hers. She's not far now.
Her aerie's right above us. I'm staying beside you. All the way.
The loveliest place on the road. Don't stop.
Slide past the chairs. Never sit.
Tap to punch the spider, or stomp it.
Tap to punch it. Don't stomp this one.
Wide gap! Flick up again midair.
Tall stump! Flick up again midair.
Tap to punch it. Don't stomp this one.
Wide gap! Flick up again midair.
Tall stump! Flick up again midair.
Nearly through. Don't slow down now.
Don't sit. That's the one on the tree.
Sleeping spiders. Flick up over them. Shh.
Tap to punch the spider, or stomp it.
It hummed! Spiders coming!
Flick up over the threads. Spiders listen.
Cakes make you slow! Flick up over them.
That cake made you slow. It wears off.
A butler! Tap to punch his tray away.
Slide past the chairs. Never sit.
Another wide one. Flick up again midair.
Another wide one. Flick up again midair.
Tall stumps. Flick up again midair.
Tall stumps. Flick up again midair.
Nearly out. Keep moving.
Quick! Flick up before the orchid shuts!
Barely afternoon, and they're closing already.
Cakes make you slow! Flick up over them.
That cake made you slow. It wears off.
Tap to punch the spider, or stomp it.
They shut sooner now. Go when one opens.
Slide past the chairs. Never sit.
Still 109 flowers to collect!
The last orchids. Nearly through.
It's sealed. Collect 83 more flowers first.
Getting late. Swing on the silk.
Flick up into the silk to swing.
Then flick up and forward to let go.
Rule five. Don't admire the silk.
Slide straight past the silk. Don't look.
Flick up at the front. Next silk line!
The Seamstress! Slide past before she looks up.
Rule five. Don't admire the silk.
Hop up high. A branch below catches misses.
Tap to punch the spider, or stomp it.
Nearly across. Don't look back at it.
Somebody's in there! Tap to punch it open.
They stopped to rest where the orchids hung in rows.
Pokey stood, because the note said so.
Tap to punch the spider, or stomp it.
Flick up over the threads. Spiders listen.

Slide past the chairs. Never sit.
Still 20 animals to free!
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
It's sealed. Free 20 more animals first.
Slide down to duck under its dive.
Slide down to duck under its dive.

It's sealed. Find 3 more messages first.

That cake made you slow. It wears off.

The shrine's shut. Beat the spiders to open it.
He won't move. He's too polite.
Still 21 predators to defeat!
A butler! Tap to punch his tray away.
Sleepy steam! Go between the puffs.
It's sealed. Defeat 21 more predators first.
Poison frog. Stomp it, never touch it.
The water's watching. Duck into the roots!
Slide down in a bush to hide!
It saw you! Slide down in a bush!

Hide! Into a bush!
Hide! Into a bush!
Too high. That root tips, though.
Poison frog. Stomp it, never touch it.
A tayra! Quick, so punch it early.
Slide down in a bush to hide!

Hide! Into a bush!
Mud! Cross while the tide is out.
Poison frog. Stomp it, never touch it.
The shrine's shut. Chase the hunters off first!
Poison frog. Stomp it, never touch it.
A tayra! Quick, so punch it early.
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
Slide down beside the fern to search it.
Still 17 predators to defeat!
It's sealed. Defeat 17 more predators first.
Too high. Stay close to the firefly, Pokey.
The roots go dark. Stay in the firefly's light.
Poison frog. Stomp it, never touch it.
High water swells that root door shut.
Slide down in a bush to hide!
